ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago (“the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance”) be amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols
and indications, as shown on Zoning Map Index 11-H, in the area bounded by

a line 234.84 feet south of and parallel to West Wilson Avenue; the alley

next east of and parallel to North Western Avenue; a line 284.84 feet south

of and parallel to West Wilson Avenue; and North Western Avenue.

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4531 North Western Avenue
